entries.source: Chance for the ability to remain available after use
entries.text: 使用后，有一定概率保持该技能可用。

entries.source: Spreads damage or healing to cards adjacent to the target, according to the indicated percentage.
entries.text: 按标示比例，将伤害或治疗扩散到目标相邻的卡牌。

entries.source: Additional damage not affected by elemental bonuses, but affected by Berserk and resistances
entries.text: 不受元素加成影响的额外伤害，但仍受狂暴与抗性影响。

entries.source: The target or effect is picked at random
Targets are picked at random among enemy cards
entries.text: 从敌方卡牌中随机选择目标。

entries.source: The player chooses among several offered options
entries.text: 玩家从给出的多个选项中作出选择。

entries.source: Percentage of damage reduced for each element
entries.text: 对应元素伤害被减免的百分比。

entries.source: Chance for an ability's damage or healing to be critical
entries.text: 技能伤害或治疗发生暴击的概率。

entries.source: Multiplier applied to critical damage and healing
entries.text: 适用于暴击伤害与暴击治疗的倍率。

entries.source: Uses remaining out of the allowed total
entries.text: 剩余可用次数与允许使用的总次数。

entries.source:
When destroyed, this card returns to life with <value1>% of its max HP.
Single use
entries.text:
此卡牌被摧毁时，以其最大生命值的 <value1>% 复活。
仅触发一次
